videos.title: Entertainment News On 5
videos.description: A daily round-up of showbiz news and gossip from around the world, focusing on celebrities, movies, music and entertainment.

videos.title: Cops
videos.description: A stolen motorcycle leads Deputies up a mountain. Deputies chase a stolen car driven by a thirteen-year-old. Kern County's Air Support Unit observes a fleeing suspect ditch his minibike.

videos.title: Police Interceptors
videos.description: The search is on for a stolen high-performance motor reportedly being used by suspects armed with baseball bats. In addition, Phil faces an electric scooter stand-off with an illegal rider.

videos.title: Police Interceptors
videos.description: The firearms team mobilises to tackle a suspect armed with a pistol. Rob and Dan pursue an under-powered runaway hatchback before the suspect decamps and makes a run for it in a fluorescent jacket.

videos.title: Police Interceptors
videos.description: Lisa and Lewis tackle a troublesome lad with a potty mouth, followed by a trip to the canal, where a member of the public has heard gunshots. Phil Broughton is hot on the heels of a fail-to-stop Ford pushing speeds of over a ton.

videos.title: Traffic Cops
videos.description: The traffic cops respond to a report of a car linked to a drunken assault with a baseball bat. On quarter-finals night, a simple case of a drunk and uninsured driver proves much more difficult to deal with.

videos.title: Traffic Cops
videos.description: Derbyshire's road crime team lead a county lines drugs crackdown in Chesterfield. Within a couple of hours, they capture three suspects who are believed to be ferrying crack cocaine and heroin into the county on a regular basis.

videos.title: Traffic Cops
videos.description: The traffic cops clamp down on young drivers causing danger on north Yorkshire's roads. In the Yorkshire Dales, the traffic cops hunt down a young man believed to be drug driving and who's failed to stop in a suspected stolen car.

videos.title: Traffic Cops
videos.description: A prolific car thief, with a string of convictions, crashes and rolls a stolen car at over 100mph. In Harrogate, the hunt for a disqualified driver leads to a high-speed car chase.

videos.title: Gunfight at the O.K. Corral
videos.description: The friendship between deadly gunfighter Doc Holliday and respected lawman Marshal Wyatt Earp forms the basis of this western saga. It builds up to the showdown at Tombstone, when the Holliday-Earp partnership destroyed the hated Clanton Gang.

videos.title: The Desperados
videos.description: In the closing days of the Civil War, fanatical Parson Josiah Galt and his three sons are leaders of a gang of southern marauders. Josiah, driven by his lust for revenge for the death of his wife, attacks the Kansas town of St Thomas. Repulsed by what he has witnessed, David leaves his Confederate war-veteran father behind and settles in Texas, where he lives in relative solitude until his father's gang invade Texas.

videos.title: Missing in Action
videos.description: Military drama in which James Braddock, a former US marine held captive in Vietnam for nearly ten years after the war ended, attempts to find a prisoners camp and liberate the prisoners to prove that soldiers are still incarcerated.

videos.title: The X-Files
videos.description: Agent Reyes theorises that a maniacal killer who critically wounded Doggett may have entered our world from a parallel dimension.

videos.title: The X-Files
videos.description: Agents Scully, Doggett and Reyes uncover ominous evidence while investigating the bizarre death of a teenager who died performing an idiotic stunt for a cable TV show.

videos.title: The X-Files
videos.description: Scully befriends a couple who believe their infant possesses the same unworldly qualities as baby William, while a shadowy operative convinces Scully to contact Mulder and draw him out of seclusion.

videos.title: The X-Files
videos.description: Doggett tries to figure out who and where he is after winding up lost in a Mexican town with no memories.

videos.title: Winter Road Rescue
videos.description: In the Highlands, snowplough teams battle blizzards, ice, flooding and landslides to keep the roads open, whilst across the UK, patrols fight snow and icy conditions.

videos.title: Winter Road Rescue
videos.description: As one of the wettest years on record draws to a close, the RAC, Scotland's Highland Council and heavy vehicle recovery companies across the UK battle to cope with chaos on the roads.

videos.title: Winter Road Rescue
videos.description: During the coldest snap of the century, huge drifts of snow trap a council plough in the Highlands, the RAC patrols battle to stay on the road to reach snowed-in motorists and heavy-recovery specialists in Northampton are pushed to the limit.

videos.title: 7th Cavalry
videos.description: Set after the Battle of Little Big Horn, a furloughed officer from Custer's ill-fated regiment searches for the truth behind his comrades' deaths.

videos.title: Face of a Fugitive
videos.description: Jim Larsen is a bank robber who hides out in a remote frontier town, but finds himself taking the law's side after falling in love with the sheriff's sister Ellen Riley. Reed Williams is a corrupt landowner trying to fence off public land who Larsen and the sheriff take on until Larson hears news that wanted posters with his face on them are on their way to town. Will he fight or flee?

videos.title: Live: NFL on 5
videos.description: Join Osi Umenyiora, Sam Quek and Efe Obada as they bring all the action from Paycor Stadium in Ohio from this grudge match between AFC North and NFC South. Can the up-and-down Saints withstand an assault from arguably the NFL's prime candidate for MVP - Joe Burrow and his coterie of circus-catching receivers?

videos.title: Cops
videos.description: A suspect on the run makes a dangerous decision when he finds himself cornered; an unsuspecting driver gets more than she bargained for when she gives an old friend a lift; a friendly woman has a thing for cowboys.

videos.title: Behind Bars: Worlds Toughest Prisons
videos.description: One of the toughest and most notorious prisons in Ukraine. It is said that no one has ever managed to escape. Over eight hundred prisoners are behind bars in Colony 8 under maximum security.

videos.title: Behind Bars: Worlds Toughest Prisons
videos.description: Maafushi Central Prison is a high-security prison covering an area the size of ten football pitches. Surrounded by six-metre-high walls, and the sea, the facility houses up to 800 criminals under the strictest security measures.

videos.title: Behind Bars: Worlds Toughest Prisons
videos.description: The pre-trial prison Urso Branco is one of the worst jails in all of Brazil. Riots have been taking place here almost every year since 2002. In the past 20 years, more than 100 people have died in riots behind the walls of Urso Branco.

videos.title: Behind Bars: Worlds Toughest Prisons
videos.description: The Correctional Institution for Women is the oldest and largest women's prison in the Philippines, where the prisoners include petty criminals, drug dealers, murders and gang members.

videos.title: Behind Bars: Worlds Toughest Prisons
videos.description: Zenica prison is the toughest prison in Bosnia and Herzegovina. Discipline and fitness are essentials that the prison administration regularly reviews.

videos.title: Police Interceptors
videos.description: It is Vicky's first pursuit, and it doesn't disappoint. After a race through Bradford, an Audi slams into a parked car. The driver runs, but the car he crashed into has a secret.

videos.title: Robbers' Roost
videos.description: Jim Wall is a taciturn outlaw who lands an honest job on the spread managed by physically disabled Hank Hayes. When Bull Herrick's sister Helen is kidnapped by crooked Hank and Heesman, Jim, seeing an opportunity to redeem himself, rides to her rescue. Fortunately for our hero, Hank and Heesman are already at each other's throats.

videos.title: The Walking Hills
videos.description: A band of treasure seekers search for a wagon train full of gold that had been buried years before somewhere in Death Valley. Of course, the closer the group gets to the gold, the higher the tension among them gets until several members of the party are killed. When a vicious sandstorm kicks up, the remaining treasure hunters scatter, but the winds reveal the location of the gold.

videos.title: Traffic Cops
videos.description: Drink-driving, drug use and atrocious weather all contribute to trouble for the traffic police as they investigate cases including a driver who is spotted taking drugs whilst behind the wheel of a car transporter.

videos.title: Police Interceptors
videos.description: It takes a stinger operation to stop a dangerous driver who reverse-rams the cops, but the interceptors are in for a surprise when they see who is behind the wheel. Plus, a dad is caught drug-driving with his child in the car.

videos.title: Police Interceptors
videos.description: Duncan pursues a driver treating Wakefield city centre like his own personal racetrack.

videos.title: Motorway Cops: Catching Britain's Speeders
videos.description: Back on the roads with Cheshire Police's elite team of motorway cops, storms and torrential rain bring travel chaos to the roads and PC Mike responds to a call for urgent backup on the night shift.

videos.title: Motorway Cops: Catching Britain's Speeders
videos.description: A car has broken down on the hard shoulder of the M6. PC Andy Doran is called in to support Highways, as they're unhappy with the driver's behaviour. When he arrives at the location, Andy quickly finds out why.

videos.title: The Great Wall of China with Dan Snow
videos.description: Dan Snow journeys across China to uncover the secrets of the Great Wall, revealing its true age and remarkable scale, and discovering why this vast frontier barrier was built.

videos.title: Highway Thru Hell
videos.description: A flaming wreckage becomes the biggest recovery of Colin's career, as snowstorms pummel the Coquihalla. Al Quiring heads up, ready for battle, and John faces off against a mangled tractor and becomes a mentor.

videos.title: The X-Files
